classification.difficultyReason: Infer rectangle dimensions from oppositely oriented tangent semicircles, then calculate a symbolic area.

content.prompt: The rectangle below contains two touching semicircles of radius $r$. Find the area of the rectangle.

spec.description: Unshaded horizontal rectangle with a left upward semicircle based on the bottom and a right downward semicircle based on the top. Both complete arcs retained; decorative blue fill omitted.
spec.mathematics: Rectangle height r; semicircle centres have vertical separation r and total separation 2r. Their horizontal separation is √3 r, giving width (2+√3)r.
spec.answerVisibility: No inferred lengths or answer labels are shown.

answer.short:
$r^2(2+\sqrt{3})$.

The rectangle has height $r$ and width $r(2+\sqrt{3})$.
answer.worked:
The rectangle’s height is $r$. The semicircle centres are $2r$ apart and have vertical separation $r$. Let their horizontal separation be $x$.
$$\begin{align*}x^2+r^2&=(2r)^2\\x^2&=3r^2\\x&=r\sqrt{3}\\W&=r+x+r\\W&=r(2+\sqrt{3})\\A&=r\times r(2+\sqrt{3})\\A&=r^2(2+\sqrt{3}).\end{align*}$$
